title: Bound on qualifying Fourier prefixes
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $f$ be a function from the Boolean cube $\{-1,1\}^n$ to $\{-1,1\}$, let $J$ be a set of coordinates, and let $\mathcal A$ be a family of subsets of the coordinates. Choose a rational threshold $\tau$ with $0<\tau\le 1$. If each $S\in\mathcal A$ is contained in $J$, and its restricted Fourier weight on $J$ is at least $\tau^2/4$, then $\mathcal A$ has cardinality at most $\lceil 4/\tau^2\rceil$.
